name: Axis Chiropractic
tagline: A chiropractic studio for neck pain, back pain and the things that stop you moving — thirty-minute visits, a clear plan, and no packages you didn't ask for.
hours_note: Closed Sundays. Same-week new patient visits.
new_patient_note: Consultation, exam, X-rays if you need them, and your first adjustment. One visit, one price.
insurance_note: In network with most major plans. We check your benefits before your first visit and tell you what you'll pay.
license_note: Dr. Nia Okafor, DC · Licensed chiropractor

first_visit.title: Talk
first_visit.body: Where it hurts, when it started, what makes it worse. We listen before we touch anything.

first_visit.title: Test
first_visit.body: Posture, range of motion, reflexes and a hands-on exam. X-rays only when the findings call for them.

first_visit.title: Treat
first_visit.body: Your first adjustment, with soft-tissue work where it helps. Every movement explained first.

first_visit.title: Plan
first_visit.body: What we found, how many visits it should take, and two stretches to do at home tonight.

doctor.name: Dr. Nia Okafor
doctor.photo_alt: Dr. Nia Okafor in an indigo scrub top, standing in the Axis treatment room

testimonial.quote: Eight months of sciatica, and I'd stopped picking up my daughter. Dr. Okafor told me it would take about six visits. It took five.
testimonial.name: Marcus T.

faqs.question: Do I need a referral?
faqs.answer: No. You can book directly. If we think something needs a doctor or a scan first, we'll tell you and point you to the right person.

faqs.question: Does an adjustment hurt?
faqs.answer: Most people feel relief, sometimes a little soreness the next day. We explain every movement before we make it, and there are gentle techniques if you'd rather skip the pop.

faqs.question: How many visits will I need?
faqs.answer: It depends on what we find. You'll get an honest estimate at the end of your first visit, and we re-check progress every few visits rather than booking you into months of care.

faqs.question: Do you take insurance?
faqs.answer: We're in network with most major plans and check your benefits before you come in. Health savings and flexible spending cards are welcome too.

faqs.question: What should I wear?
faqs.answer: Something comfortable you can move in. No need to change — we work over clothing.

art_direction.identity: Upright and poster-clean: bone-paper canvas, deep indigo ink, one vermilion accent, calm natural-light studio photography. Feels like a well-set anatomy chart, never a clinic stock site.
art_direction.type: Sofia Sans Condensed (semibold, tight) for every heading, set tall and large; Instrument Sans for body and UI. Headlines are short and upright.
art_direction.color: One accent: vermilion (bg-primary) for the primary button, the lit vertebrae in the spine map, and a small focal mark. Indigo (bg-secondary) carries exactly one dark band — the first visit ruler. Everything else is bone canvas, card, ink and muted text. Never add another color.
art_direction.signature: The spine map — an S-curved spine built from stacked vertebrae beside the conditions treated; hovering a condition lights the vertebrae of its region. Keep it wherever the design evolves.
art_direction.voice: Calm, plain, physical. Short sentences and real numbers. No 'wellness journey', no exclamation marks, no promises of cures.
